snippet.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition is the ultimate Dawn of War experience, featuring the original Dawn of War and all its expansions, along with enhanced visuals, an improved camera, and 64-bit platform support.
